theorems.name: Submission.dimred_tr_bc_currentEval_blowUp
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n), currentEval (blowUp T x lam hlam.ne') ω = currentEval T (affinePullbackForm (dilationCLM P lam) (-(lam⁻¹ • x)) ω)
